title: Always Evolving
body: This planner had changed my life and made organisational task so much easier to navigate. It can be as simple or as complex as you like. The journal, habit tracker, calendar and planners are like having 4 apps all in one space that function the same, and are aesthetically the same. Great for my personal ADHD preferences. There is a great community forum for collaborative ideas, both from the creators and users. And it’s always being updated and improved. I think I’ll use this for life.
author: isekatyelop

author: plebbles24

title: Seems fine but premium is a con
body: App seems well made, but £8 per month for one way sync on a calendar that I can just put in a split window next to the app anyway is taking the absolute Mickey out of users. This is a basic, basic feature that’s been locked behind a paywall, it is not a premium feature. Save your money, use stage manager. Cheeky and greedy. For that reason I won’t be using the app at all, I prefer not to give money to devs who rip people off knowing most people won’t know better. Shame because the integration of habits and journal is nice but not if you’re going to take liberties like that. Do better, stop ripping your users off.
